comment: The implementations of the template language and the shared units that each holds, checked by make parity-declarations-check and make parity-check of kit (T24.7). The API units are the operations and types that the specification defines as public API (T22.6-14, T22.6-18), read by the symbol extractor of each implementation; every other public symbol is a nativeOnly entry with the spec anchor of its reason. The conformance cases of tests/cases, their tokens and format results and the expression vectors of tests/fixtures/expr/cases.json are the shared suites; the editor packages, the compiler and the repository tools are single-language tools; every other test file of an implementation is the native test of a feature unit (T24.8, T24.11).

profiles.name: manifest
profiles.reason: The PHP extension is the native renderer of the PHP package and declares no support level of packages/compiler/interface.json and no entry of the function contract (RT-55, RT-56): its PHP surface is Engine (parse, analyze, render and register over a template directory), BoundMap and TemplateError, so the loader interface, the artifact refresh of a program, the page cache, the value and number operations, the function registry, the formatter and the declarations of the manifest mapping are absent: the program interface and its AST program, the prepared render, the runtime services, environment and bindings and the render frame, scope and context of generated programs (compiler.md, public structures), the decode of an AST (AST-10) and the JSON parser of the package (VAL-12, VAL-22), and a PHP host reaches them in the PHP package that the extension requires.

profiles.name: export-list
profiles.reason: Names follow the conventions of each language (RT-1): the TypeScript and Python packages name their public API in an export list, the re-exports of the entry points of package.json and __all__ with the package data of pyproject.toml, which a test keeps complete; Go, Rust and PHP export a declaration by its visibility, which their compilers check.

profiles.name: language-service
profiles.reason: The language service and its command template-fmt, the editor documents and the template root are one TypeScript package, @polyspec/template-language, which the editor adapters use (EDT layers).

profiles.name: concurrent-renders
profiles.reason: Renders of one program run at the same time where the host language runs code concurrently (RT-70): Go renders one program and one bound map from concurrent goroutines and Python from concurrent threads, while a Rust program and its bound maps stay in the thread that created them, TypeScript and PHP run one render at a time in a process or worker, and the PHP extension keeps the objects of a request in that request.

profiles.name: checked-arguments
profiles.reason: The parameters of bind and merge accept any value where the host language checks types at run time (VAL-22): TypeScript, PHP, the PHP extension and Python check inside the operation that the argument of merge is a bound map of the same implementation, while Go and Rust declare the bound map type of the parameter, which their compilers check.
